propositions: A child ticket closed with disposition class (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) and a live replacement link is exempt from completion verification during close, but the certification path still requires a completion-verifier attestation, creating an uncertifiable state.

No non-force remedy exists: reopening and re-closing takes the same exemption branch, force-close produces unsigned state, and all manual workarounds require misrepresenting the ticket (false close class, deleted link, or de-parenting).

The close path and certification path implement conflicting rules for disposition-closed children: transition_close.py:253-260 exempts them from verifier requirement, but child_closure_findings requires valid completion-verifier on every closed child.

A disposition-closed child with live replacement link should resolve certification through that link (certified iff replacement is certified), not demand an attestation the child is exempt from producing.
The fix mints a completion-verifier attestation with manifest reading DISPOSITION <class> plus replacement id, not claiming a PASS that never happened, while keeping force-close unsigned.
